english: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
text: 这里不用 they have tried，而用 have been trying，是想突出从大火扑灭到现在一直在做、且还在继续的调查动作。如果只想说“试过了”，用 have tried 也对；想强调“一直在忙活、还没停”，就选 have been doing。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
